# FAA TFMSC business-jet daily counts (real data)

Source: FAA Traffic Flow Management System Counts (TFMSC), Airport view, https://www.aspm.faa.gov/tfms/sys/Airport.asp
(public, no login). Pulled 2026-10-24 by Role 2 for the P2 blind backtest. `source` = `faa_tfmsc` in every row.

| File | Rows | Coverage |
|---|---|---|
| `vny_bizjet_daily.csv` | 632 | KVNY, every day Jan 1 – Mar 31 of 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026 |
| `super_bowl_hosts_bizjet_daily.csv` | 2,950 | 7 Super Bowl host regions, Jan 1 – Mar 15 of the game year (2019–2026, no 2021) |

Query (generated by the TFMSC form; Business Jet = Yes, all other filters = all, one airport list per region):

```sql
SELECT YYYYMMDD, LOCID, SUM(DEP_CNT) AS departures, SUM(ARR_CNT) AS arrivals
FROM LOCIDSUMS WHERE YYYYMMDD >= <start> AND YYYYMMDD <= <end> AND LOCID IN (<airports>) AND B_JET='Y'
GROUP BY YYYYMMDD, LOCID ORDER BY YYYYMMDD, LOCID
```

Host-region airports (an assumption; chosen as the business-jet airports around each stadium):
LA 2022 VNY BUR LAX SMO HHR LGB SNA CMA WHP ONT TOA · Atlanta 2019 ATL PDK FTY LZU RYY · Miami 2020 MIA OPF FLL FXE
PBI TMB BCT · Phoenix 2023 PHX SDL DVT IWA CHD GYR GEU · Las Vegas 2024 LAS HND VGT BVU · New Orleans 2025 MSY NEW ·
Bay Area 2026 SJC SFO OAK PAO HWD CCR LVK.

Integrity: rows were read from the TFMSC result pages in the browser and written here; every file and every event
was checked against a checksum computed in the browser (row count, departure sum, arrival sum, weighted sum). All match.

Caveats:
- TFMSC counts flights in TFMS (flight plans / NAS tracking) with business-jet equipment codes; flights without a
  plan or radar track are missing, and a "business jet" is an equipment type, not a business-aviation operator.
- Dates: the FAA manual says the date comes from the departure/arrival (DZ/AZ) message or flight-plan activation.
  Those messages are in UTC, so the dates are probably UTC days (a Los Angeles arrival after 16:00 PST lands on the
  next date). Not confirmed by the FAA documentation.
- TFMSC omits airport-days with no flights, so a missing row means 0.
- Known anomalies, excluded from baselines in `contracts/assumptions.yaml` (`forecast.real_data.exclude`): COVID
  from mid-March 2020; LA wildfires January 2025 (VNY near zero 2025-01-07/08); VNY near-zero spans in January 2026
  (treated as a data gap); New Orleans snowstorm 2025-01-21/22.
- Acquisition is normally Role 1's job; Role 1 can move these into `data/processed` if the team agrees.
